description: fnpf_2d_break_a350_5_deep with the Gamma strength of Derakhti et al. (2018) (A 367 2): Gamma = T_b dB/dt fitted over |B - Bth| < A 411 of the crest's samples, x A 359/Bth. On this coarse grid (dx 3 m) Gamma stays below 0.3, so the breakers are tracked for 0.75 T_b with b = 0.
covers: breaking_crest3d::rays model 5 with the Gamma window fit (deep 1)
